name: darsi
description: Darsi (درسي) — offline-first PWA that upskills teachers in AI, IoT and cyber security. Web first, Capacitor-ready for Android and iOS.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @darsi/design-system && npm run build -w @darsi/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @darsi/design-system && npm run test -w @darsi/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @darsi/design-system && npm run typecheck -w @darsi/web
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npm run cap:sync -w @darsi/web
